description.value: Hansel and Gretel Bakery is an owner-operated artisan bakery in Maple Ridge, founded in 2015 by Craig and Claudia Storer, who bring decades of Vancouver restaurant and pastry experience to their craft. The shop specializes in elaborate custom celebration and wedding cakes alongside everyday treats — muffins, cookies, loaf slices, crème brûlée, and bannock — made with local and natural ingredients. Touring cyclists passing through Maple Ridge will find a welcoming spot for a sweet refuel, with beverages (drip coffee and tea) also on offer.

address.value: 22777 Dewdney Trunk Road, Maple Ridge, BC V2X 3K4

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at hanselandgretelbakery.ca confirms this is a real, actively operating artisan bakery at 22777 Dewdney Trunk Road, Maple Ridge, BC, with phone 604-463-0034 — neither of which appears in the OSM record. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any cycling-specific amenity appears anywhere on the site, so all amenity fields remain null per absence-of-evidence rules. OSM categorizes this as 'Groceries' via shop=bakery, but it is a specialty patisserie/cake shop rather than a general grocery — worth flagging but not grounds for exclusion.

Category assigned as 'Groceries' via shop=bakery, but this is a specialty patisserie/cake shop, not a general grocery store.
